scenario.title: Battery-charger buy with eligibility, withdrawal, and question-driven recovery
scenario.summary: The real DLA Aviation requirement is a total small-business set-aside for 34 chargers with 167-day ADO. The initial best eligible supplier withdraws; the remaining eligible late supplier asks a delivery question before issuing a compliant revision.

realism.notes: The 34-unit quantity, 167-day ADO, and total small-business set-aside are real public facts. Supplier behavior and prices are synthetic.

calibration_sources.title: FAR 15.306 Exchanges with offerors after receipt of proposals
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for clarification/discussion events; not governing law for non-U.S. episodes.

calibration_sources.title: FAR 15.206 Amending the solicitation
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for buyer requirement changes and solicitation amendments.

calibration_sources.title: UNDP How we buy
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for evaluating quotations on compliance, price, delivery, and other factors.

objective.description: Reach an award-ready procurement decision without violating the real starting constraints or scenario facts revealed during the episode.

suppliers.notes: Synthetic supplier used only inside this episode.
Cheaper but ineligible under the real small-business set-aside.
Initially late; later revises after a supplier question.

events.observation: Supplier A quotes USD 102,000 for 34 chargers with 160-day delivery.
Supplier B quotes USD 86,000 with 150-day delivery but is not small-business eligible.
Supplier C quotes USD 96,000 for 34 chargers with 180-day delivery.
Supplier A withdraws its quotation before award.
Supplier C asks whether the 167-day ADO is firm for the full quantity.

details.question: Is the 167-day ADO firm for all 34 chargers?

events.observation: After confirmation, Supplier C revises to USD 99,000 for 34 chargers with 165-day delivery.

hard_constraints.description: Awarded supplier must satisfy the real total small-business set-aside.
Award must cover the real quantity of 34 chargers.
Delivery must satisfy the real 167-day ADO requirement.
A withdrawn supplier cannot receive award.
Only the latest revealed revision for a supplier may support award.

acceptable_terminal_outcomes.rationale: After Supplier A withdraws, Supplier C's revision is the remaining eligible offer meeting quantity and delivery.

failure_conditions: Awarding the cheaper ineligible Supplier B.

economic_objective.description: Among remaining eligible feasible active offers, prefer the lowest total awarded price.
